Method of Attack: Delivered via emails from spoofed address
Malware attached as a small (1MB) IMG disc-image file to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Small Business Administration COVID-19 loan relief accounts
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with subject 'SBA Application - Review and Proceed' from spoofed email 'disastercustomerservice@sba.gov'
Links to fake SBA sign-in pages
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing email subject line: 'SBA Application - Review and Proceed'
Phishing pages hosted on multiple domains including some with Brazil TLD
Malware attached as 1MB IMG disc-image file
